author: Whatfinger
title: AfD: Trump is a good example for conservative parties in Europe | DW News - World News
text:
Members of the AfD, the right-wing German party, are becoming regulars in Washington, meeting with Donald Trump’s administration to “tie the bonds,” as Markus Frohnmaier told DW’s Bureau Chief Ines Pohl during an interview. She asked him about the commonalities between the MAGA movement and his party, as well as the significance of Donald Trump’s support and that of his cabinet, not only for the AfD but also for other right-wing parties across Europe.
